nativeDefaults.text: this.rulesExpanded ? '收起层级规则' : '本书目录层级规则'

carriers.text: this.book !== undefined && this.book.contentKind === 'manga' ? '章节目录' : '目录'

this.book !== undefined && this.book.contentKind === 'manga' ? this.mangaSummaryLabel() :
          `${this.toc.filter((entry: LocalReadingTocEntry): boolean => entry.navigable !== false).length} 个可读条目`

this.book.contentKind === 'manga' &&
        (entry.title.trim().length === 0 || entry.title.trim() === '第话' || entry.title.trim() === '第 话') ?
        `第${Math.max(1, entry.index + 1)}话` : entry.title

this.controller?.replacementRecoveryRequired === true ? '内容已更新，从新版首图开始' : '内容已更新，确认从当前页继续'
this.title.includes('卷') ? '重新打开本卷' : '重新打开本话'

nativeDefaults.text: this.loggingIn ? '登录处理中' : '登录书源后重试'
